mechanism: The owner-first pool gate (the original's order at 0x4bc0) loads the pool AccountInfo pointer once, as the original does. Greedy then colours it r6, where the original has r7 because r6 holds the sharing tag across the curve block and gate. That colour ripples into the sweep-region tag pieces, and post-RA placement then moves the 108-insn 284/556 error chain (~0x5568 -> ~0x3c48; orig 0x5808). This is why every pool-region form (po, ph/hr, a2, pu1, p2) lands near 0.633. Greedy splits the tag (whole-function interval) last, after old_fee, the pool ptr and pool_updated already hold r6..r9 there, so ours never gives the tag the r6 region. The source has no other use of the tag in that range.
